adaptations.B1: Keep the result-first two-drink hook while replacing the source ocean-lettered glasses with the supplied fish-pattern double-wall glass.
adaptations.B2: Retain the tactile empty-glass rotation so the target silhouette and fish motif are visible before ingredients enter.
adaptations.B3-B5: Recreate the ice, citrus, clear pour and bubble macro as a transparent cold-drink sequence without source branding.
adaptations.B6-B7: Recreate the second drink as ice, milk and coffee in separate continuous shots, followed by the paired result.
adaptations.B8-B9: Finish with stirring, a single-hand lift toward the lens and a return to the opening hero composition.

lines.visual_direction: Begin on two finished drinks in matching fish-pattern glasses; snap focus from soft to crisp and hold the fresh paired result.
lines.delivery: Silent visual beat; music or natural ambience only.

lines.visual_direction: Two hands tilt and rotate one empty glass by a quarter turn, revealing its double wall, fish motif, rim and thick base.
Metal tongs place several clear ice cubes into the upright glass and finish with one small citrus slice.
A full-size 1.5-litre household clear glass water pitcher pours sparkling water in one steady stream over the ice while the glass remains centred and upright.
Hold an extreme close-up of the completed clear drink while fine bubbles rise around the ice and citrus through the fish-pattern double wall.
In three separate shots, lift away the completed clear drink, load ice into a second matching glass, then pour in milk.
lines.delivery: Silent three-shot transition into the second drink.

lines.visual_direction: Pour dark coffee into the iced milk to create a natural colour bloom, then cut to both completed drinks resting side by side.
lines.delivery: Silent transformation followed by a result hold.

lines.visual_direction: Stir the clear citrus drink with one transparent stirrer while the milk coffee remains still beside it.
Lift the clear drink toward the lens for a soft glass wipe, then return to the paired finished-drink hero and hold.
lines.delivery: Silent closing gesture and final hold.
